newsitem.title: UK: Argonaut to switch tanker ship managers.
newsitem.headline: Argonaut to switch tanker ship managers.

text.p: Sweden's Argonaut AB said on Tuesday that it was switching the management of its fleet of six VLCCs and one ULCC to Barber Ship Management, a unit of Norway's Wilh. Wilhelmsen Ltd ASA.

Argonaut said the contract was being moved from London-based Interocean Ugland Management as a result of the Ugland group's decision to concentrate all its technical ship management and crewing activities at Grimstad in southern Norway.

The switch will be implemented during the autumn as the chartering position of each vessel provides a suitable opportunity, Argonaut said. It will be completed before the end of 1997. -Reuters Shipping News + 44 171 542 4087. Fax 5017
